recipes.title: Berry Basil Seed Gelatin Bites

items.i: honey or monk fruit, to taste

steps: Soak the basil seeds in water for about 10 minutes until they swell and turn gel-like.
Divide the berries between the cups of a silicone donut or muffin mold.
Bloom the gelatin in a little cold water, then whisk in hot water or juice until dissolved. Stir in the honey, lemon juice and soaked basil seeds.
Pour over the berries and refrigerate until firm, about 2 hours, then pop out of the molds.
recipes.notes: Estimated recipe: the creator didn't post amounts, so quantities and macros are estimates from what the video shows. The fiber from the seeds and protein from the gelatin are why it's billed as a filling, appetite-friendly snack; agar works for a vegetarian version.
